Faction lost it space by experimental drive mounted on city ship, wormhole drive as it was called then suffered malfuncion and dropped city and its inhabitants near planet Oberon without power to engines. Rest is history.
UNSF Requisition branch supplies the biggest ship, most powerful weapons and wings. Outsiders are usually not trusted to be issued such a tools, but well trusted individuals might get to buy some.

Aegirgast, a gigastation built in the shadow of the shattered planet Aegir, is the lifeblood of the UNSF. The exposed resource veins of Aegir's remains are mined relentlessly, fueling the faction’s growing economy, driving industrial production, and sustaining its military might with unmatched efficiency.

Nidavellir, a gargantuan station orbiting perilously close to the star Nyxara, taps directly into solar energy, transforming it into the lifeblood of UNSF’s industry. Here, alloys are forged, ships take form, and the foundations of the faction’s expanding civilization are meticulously constructed.

Atlantis Station, affectionately dubbed 'New Atlantis' by locals, is a repository of the precious technologies scavenged from the ruins of its namesake, now submerged deep beneath Oberon’s oceans. This floating relic stands as both a symbol of UNSF's past and a beacon of its technological future, where each piece of recovered technology fuels progress and hope.
Ignara, the lone giant of the Niltrof system, only body with stable orbit, anchoring the system’s single jump point. Its importance to UNSF as the gateway to the system is immeasurable.

Oberon, a serene water world, bore witness to a cataclysmic event—the crash-landing of an entire city. This violent impact marked the planet’s first colonization, and though the city shield remained intact, city did not, and its wreckage rapidly sunk beneath he waves, the UNSF has since adapted to the challenges of settling a world of endless oceans scavenging what they can from only memory to their home.

Argos, a frozen world of endless tundras and sub-zero temperatures, now serves as the backbone of UNSF’s fuel production efforts. Here, in the planet’s icy depths and harsh cold environment are exploited by cutting-edge refineries for massive fuel production.
Basic missile and fighter defense system, shoots explosive projectiles to intercept incomming munitions and fighters.
Cornerstone of every UNSF ship is multipurpose railgun, this small variant is perfect for defending against incoming munitions, fighters or for supressing enemy that got too close.
Take two Type-1s make them larger and then weld them together. Perfect for cruisers as primary PD and suppresion weapon.
This is evolution of railgun technology where slugs and rails are replaced by pulse charged coils and small charged-plasma capsules.

After recovering first files on pulse weapon research from lost Atlantis, development started on large scale pulse cannons, resulting prototypes are now fitted to all UNSF battlecruisers as medium range weaponery.
Old Asgard designs of plasma beam weapons are well known for their power but less known for their relatively short range without massive powersupply.
Evolution of Old Asgard technology upgraded by tachyon beam blueprints supplied by out TriTech allies.

A lot could be said but Alteran poem describes it best: "Craft of minds from ancient days, forged in wisdom's endless gaze, I seek no throne, no crown, no name, but strike with force from which I came."
